summary: Full resolution of Codex Review Findings C1-C5 and Frontend CI Budget for DRIVE-01-F07: (CI) Frontend dynamic route JS budget fully resolved with /movies/[id] at 143,104 gzip bytes (< 143,360 bytes / 140 KiB, 256 bytes headroom), all 4 routes PASS, and all 83 test suites PASS; (C1) Generic metadata cleanup handle retention fully resolved via recordFailedCleanup(resource, opName, cause, null, false) in DriveIoExecutor, verified by DRIVE_F06_metadata_cleanup.java (exit 0) and DriveGenericMetadataReproTest (2/2 PASS); (C2) Process ownership secured by removing broad Stop-Process from DRIVE_SNAPSHOT_RUNBOOK.md and implementing fail-closed PID/StartTime verified stop_backend_dev.ps1; (C3) Clean isolated snapshot contract established with dedicated snapshot profile in application.yml (./data/snapshot/moviercm_snapshot_db), non-mutating seeding in DataInitializer, and self-building loopback start_backend_dev.ps1; (C4) Strict browser verification implemented in test_live_browser_f07.cjs asserting UI control interaction, decoded video geometry, and post-seek frame advancement (t2 > t1 + 0.5s) with nonzero exit on failure; (C5) Truthful disclosures published, DRIVE_SNAPSHOT_RUNBOOK.md included in patch and manifest, and clean reconstruction from base fe55916 verified 100% (23/23 files matched); all background services and mounts cleanly stopped.

CI_routeJsBudget.finding: Route /movies/[id] exceeded 140 KiB budget (143,469 gzip bytes > 143,360 bytes, +109 bytes).
CI_routeJsBudget.resolution: Optimized CineBot, MovieSection, and catalogService without dropping features or bypassing measurement scripts. Production build measures 143,104 gzip bytes (256 bytes comfortable headroom below 143,360). All 83 test suites and 5/5 negative tests pass.

C1_genericMetadataCleanup.finding: executeWithTimeout admitted AutoCloseable results without lifecycle reservation, silently dropping native close failures under full capacity in closeResourceSafely and recordUnreservedFailedCleanup.
C1_genericMetadataCleanup.resolution: Enforced non-dropping handle retention via recordFailedCleanup(resource, opName, closeEx, null, false). Retained handles track failedCleanupObligations and dynamically acquire pending permits upon retry when queue space is available. Drains cleanly across shutdown.

C2_snapshotRunbookShutdown.finding: DRIVE_SNAPSHOT_RUNBOOK.md lines 96-98 selected all node/python/java by executable path and killed them, risking termination of unrelated user services.
C2_snapshotRunbookShutdown.resolution: Replaced broad kill snippet with Option A (foreground Ctrl+C) and Option B (scripts/stop_backend_dev.ps1 and scripts/drive/stop_drive.ps1) enforcing fail-closed identity verification of PID, ProcessName 'java', and process StartTime.

C3_isolatedSnapshotContract.finding: start_backend_dev.ps1 assumed existing build outputs, did not set cwd or loopback address, and dev profile used shared ./data/moviercm_db while DataInitializer mutated existing movies with 'Animation,'.
C3_isolatedSnapshotContract.resolution: Added dedicated 'snapshot' profile in application.yml pointing datasource to ./data/snapshot/moviercm_snapshot_db. Removed existing movie genre mutation in DataInitializer (lines 223-229). Updated start_backend_dev.ps1 to auto-build classes/classpath via mvnw, sync resources, bind to 127.0.0.1:8080, and track PID. Verified empty DB vs existing DB restart idempotency.
C3_isolatedSnapshotContract.tests: First run: 13 movies added, 50 users seeded; Restart run: 0 movies added, 0 mutations, exact matching genres

C4_browserVerificationStrictness.finding: test_live_browser_f06.cjs warned instead of failing if playback never started, did not interact with player controls, and did not assert post-seek decoded frame advancement.
C4_browserVerificationStrictness.resolution: Created scripts/test_live_browser_f07.cjs interacting with real UI button [data-testid='video-play-pause-btn'], checking videoWidth > 0 && videoHeight > 0, asserting seek settling, and asserting decoded frame advancement (t2 > t1 + 0.5s) with nonzero exit on failure.

C5_reportScopeAndDisclosures.finding: Report overclaimed instant seeks, did not distinguish HTTP chat from browser rendering, and omitted DRIVE_SNAPSHOT_RUNBOOK.md from patch.
C5_reportScopeAndDisclosures.resolution: Truthfully disclosed WAN streaming latency (~11-19s cold start, ~11-14s seek), video-only DASH stream nature, RAM buffer vs disk, and separate HTTP/browser chat contracts. Included DRIVE_SNAPSHOT_RUNBOOK.md in patch and manifest, verifying 23/23 files match 100% in clean reconstruction.
C5_reportScopeAndDisclosures.reconstruction: 23/23 files matched in isolated worktree at base commit fe55916
